semantic.justification: Original static ZipOutputStream::setEntry and getCurrentDosTime now provide version20, UTF8 flag reset, DEFLATED method fallback, unknown CRC/size descriptor decisions and UTC DOS packing through actual TimeValue/oslDateTime owners. Existing STORE package output calls setEntry rather than supplying a constant1980 timestamp, and LOC writes zero CRC/sizes when source bit3 is set. The source checked year assertion, ignored OSL success statuses, uint32 TimeValue seconds wrapping and all-ones CRC sentinel collision are preserved, not repaired. Date is the explicit browser CLOCK_REALTIME/gmtime primitive boundary with millisecond precision; native OS failures, submillisecond clock precision, ABI/thread behavior, chrono constructors and unconsumed OSL time functions remain unverified or unported. Full native ZipOutputStream threadpool/deflate/ZIP64/encryption/package/output-storage and DOCX/XLSX model/filter/Worker/UI acceptance remain unfinished. Browser open/save/autosave/recovery policies are unchanged.
